lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 to 14 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is tightest at the shoulder region and becomes significantly wider and more irregular across the central abdominal area.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 5th vertical line from the anterior, splitting toward the dorsal ridge. A second convergence is visible between the 8th and 9th lines at the ventral boundary.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most lines (11-14) are fragmented into short, dashed segments that do not span the full height of the flank.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 7 to 9 high-contrast white spots is localized on the upper hind limb and posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three spots is visible on the mid-thigh, forming a semi-linear geometric pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: White patch on the inner/anterior carpal region of the forelimb; white spot visible on the lower cheek; dark hair ridge along the dorsal midline; tail exhibits a dark terminal tuft.
